name: @slapdash/evals
description: Eval suite for Claude builds: scripted scenarios run through the real agent loop in Node against the real Claude API (in-process keyhole), checking the model that comes out (counts, dimensions, openings, joints, clashes) and recording tokens and cost per turn against the monthly cap. On demand only (costs money); deliberately no test script, so pnpm -r test never calls the API. self-check runs offline.
